items.name: corn on the cob (2 short rounds, kernels only)
items.preparation: boiled or steamed, cut into short cob rounds, no visible butter or sauce

scale_cues: White square plate assumed to be about 25 cm across; each cob round is about 5 cm in diameter relative to the plate. The overhead view hides the length of each round, which I assumed to be about 3-4 cm.
assumptions: Grams are the edible kernels only; the inedible cob core is excluded (total with cob would be about 110-140 g).
Each round is assumed to be about 3-4 cm long, since the overhead view shows only the cut ends.
No butter, oil or salt is added; the surface looks dry with no visible sheen or pooling.
Calories use cooked sweet corn at about 96 kcal and 3.4 g protein per 100 g.
